title: Decompression landmarks
view: The right bony thorax from the front, head at the top, the patient's right on the image left: clavicle, sternum, ribs 1-7.
teachingPoint: Preferred: the 4th or 5th intercostal space at the anterior axillary line; alternate: the 2nd intercostal space at the midclavicular line.
claims: Right hemithorax from the front, patient's right on the image left (house laterality; the record says choose the side clinically).
Teal at the AAL: the 4th and 5th intercostal spaces (record, preferred site).
Teal at the MCL: the 2nd intercostal space, below the 2nd rib whose cartilage meets the sternal angle (record, alternate site).
Dashed: the midclavicular line through the clavicle's midpoint, about 9.5 cm from the midline, and the anterior axillary line about 14 cm out (standard adult anatomy).
Labels: Clavicle, 2nd ICS, MCL, 4th–5th ICS, AAL, Midclavicular line, Anterior axillary line.
